ălōpex , ĕcis, f., = ἀλωπεκίας,
I.a kind of shark, also called, in pure Lat., volpes marina, sea - fox, thresher - shark: squalus vulpes, Cuv.; Plin. 32, 11, 53, § 145; cf.: “volpes marinae simili in periculo glutiunt,” id. 9, 43, 67, § 145 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
